dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: You go ahead and get some rest — I wanna survey this area first. We need to get some sort of security system in place, just in case of a surprise attack...

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Oh yeah — I'm guessing you've got all your essential supplies on you? If you're going to put them down, make sure it's somewhere everyone can see them.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Oh, you want to come with me? Sure, that'll save us some time. Alright, come with me, and stick close.
